sourceSets.name: source_list
sourceSets.description: List allowed original source paths, sizes and line counts. No source is implicitly read into analysis.

sourceSets.name: source_search
sourceSets.description: Search literal text in the session's allowed source index, returning numbered source lines and evidence IDs after revalidating each matching original. Source changes require fresh analysis; this does not rebuild the index. Optional relative file or directory path ('.' means all indexed files) filters the existing index only.

sourceSets.name: source_symbol
sourceSets.description: Locate lexical symbol candidates with paths and original ranges; optional relative file or directory path filters the existing allowed index only. All ambiguous candidates are returned; read bodies explicitly. This is not a call graph.

sourceSets.name: source_read
sourceSets.description: Read an original source line range; an end beyond EOF returns the available lines with actual evidence bounds. No shell, writes, network or target execution.

sourceSets.name: source_structure
sourceSets.description: Inspect AST-bound calls and inherited receiver relations for a shown symbolId. Metadata is a source-location candidate, not body evidence or authorization semantics. Unknown/dynamic bindings remain gaps.
